pages.title: Chronoplastic Casing
pages.text: A casing laced with tachyon crystal and a chronon capacitor, so that time inside flows at a rate I can adjust. It feels slightly out of sync with the rest of the world, as though the hand touching it is one heartbeat late.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Time-manipulating machines bled their effects onto their own housings. I built a casing whose clock could be set independently, using tachyons to reach ahead and a chronon capacitor to store the difference.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Anomaly Containment Ward, Causal Shielding Plate, Causality Loop Engine, Chronal Accelerator, Chrono Loom, Evolution Engine.
